observed_semantic_gaps.finding: CompressionMode::Lz4 carries level -1..=16, but the writer always calls compress_prepend_size and never passes or interprets level.
CompressionMode::Auto is documented as a 1 MiB threshold, but is_compressed is unconditional and AUTO_COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD has no runtime use.
Compression byte 1 collapses Lz4 and Auto; reading a compressed artifact always reconstructs Lz4 { level: 1 }, so neither requested level nor Auto intent is persisted.
The registry calls the capability block/frame, but the trace implementation accepts and emits only size-prepended LZ4 blocks inside the ASUPERTRACE container.
EVD-TRACE-LZ4 points to tests/trace_compression_conformance.rs, which tests semantic event filtering rather than the persisted LZ4 byte codec.
The excluded fuzz manifest requests lz4_flex 0.13 while production resolves 0.14.0; its ignored lockfile is not clean-HEAD proof.
No retained historical compressed trace corpus is registered, despite v2/v3 backward-read and migration claims.
The declared lz4_trace_replay, lz4_cross_version_artifact, and lz4_malformed_limits scenarios are not registered canonical E2E scenarios.
The advertised output length is capped before decode, but each reader allocates both the compressed chunk and a decompressed Vec; no combined peak-memory measurement is retained.
ATP has five production lz4_flex encode/decode/size consumers outside CAP-TRACE-LZ4; removing the root edge cannot be authorized from trace evidence alone.
ATP decoders compare expected size only after lz4_flex allocates and decodes the advertised size-prepended block.

resource_envelope.writer_behavior: Buffers canonical event frames to chunk_size, then allocates the incumbent compressed Vec before writing.
resource_envelope.reader_behavior: Allocates the bounded compressed Vec, validates the four-byte advertised output length, then replaces decompressed_buffer with the incumbent output Vec.
resource_envelope.cutover_requirement: A4 must retain a measured combined peak and prove no expansion, allocation, integer, truncation, or recovery regression at all boundaries.
